entities.summary: Malkara is a municipality and district of Tekirdağ Province, Turkey. Its area is 1,243 km2, and its population is 50,988 (2022). It is located at 55 km west of Tekirdağ and 190 km from Istanbul. The mayor is Nergiz Karaağaçlı Öztürk (CHP).
